This review is out of my personal experience. To me St Mina is probably one of the best animal clinics. I have been bringing my Loki here for 2 years and have never had a complaint not once. The staff is amazingly superb. They're caring and receptive to the needs of the fur baby. They take their time explaining everything and you can ask as many questions as you like and you will get an honest answer. They're not highly priced like other animal clinics are. The wait time is fairly short but of course the most critical need to come first.
They explain the type of test that are needed and why and the cost as well. They also let you know which test you can hold off on. But it is crucial if your fur baby needs blood work please get the blood work it says a lot about what is wrong with the fur baby. I brought my Loki to Blue Pearl Sunday night and had a horrible experience and got no answers just to have to rush Loki to St Mina first thing in the morning as soon as they opened. They took Loki right away asked some questions called Blue Pearl but they were useless they said the vet was still making his notes. From the night before I highly doubt it. They probably knew something was wrong didn't want to tell me. At St Mina they took blood work and an X-ray got the results right away and pin pointed what was wrong.
To the whole entire staff at St Mina you guys are great and I don't think you get enough praise for the caring compassionate treatment you provide to fur babies of all kinds. Thank you from the bottom of my heart. GOD BLESS all you.
Sincerely
Loki's mom Denise White
Okay, but I think the prices are expensive.
Dr. Popac is wonderful and I received excellent service, plus it was very affordable.

I had a fantastic experience at St Mina Animal Clinic in Jamaica! The care provided by the nurses and the veterinarian was excellent. They were so kind, and we felt truly welcome from the moment we arrived. My puppy, Kira, was received with such great affection.
​I want to highlight the great value this place offers: the prices are very affordable, and they have excellent long-term health plans for your pets. I highly recommend them—they are super, super, super excellent
Another huge benefit is that all the staff are bilingual, which makes it so easy to translate your concerns from Spanish to English. I left there absolutely delighted. I highly recommend that everyone come here; this is going to be our go-to veterinary clinic for our pets

I am very disappointed with my experience at St. Mina Health Care. I brought my cat in because she was having serious symptoms, including constipation, gagging after eating, a hard stomach, repeatedly defecating outside of the litter box, and an infection or rash on her chin.

When I tried to explain my concerns, the doctor dismissed them and responded with a joke, saying, “We all have poop in our stomach.” I found this unprofessional and insensitive, especially when I was genuinely worried about my pet’s health.

Prior to this visit, my cat underwent blood work, X-rays, and other tests that cost approximately $700. Despite the testing, the only treatment provided was a stool softener, which did not resolve the problem and appeared to make her condition worse.

What concerned me even more was that when I asked what might be causing my cat’s symptoms, the doctor told me he did not know and that he only knew what treatment to give. After spending hundreds of dollars on diagnostic tests, I expected a more thorough explanation, possible causes, or at least a discussion of next steps.

As a pet owner, I expect veterinarians to take concerns seriously, communicate professionally, and provide clear information about a pet’s condition. Instead, I felt my concerns were dismissed, my questions went unanswered, and my cat did not receive the level of care I was hoping for.

Based on my experience, I would not recommend this clinic to pet owners seeking thorough, compassionate, and communicative veterinary care.
The workers are always sociable and very reliable to your service of your pet

I found a stray cat that was a little bit injured and very scared and possibly traumatized It was a little aggressive in the beginning I got him in a cat carrier I took him to Saint Mina's their staff was so excellent The level of care the conversation they took care of him to the best of their ability I will definitely be going back there and I adopted the little fella and named him Logan another member of my family 😺

My puppy was bitten by a squirrel.
They shaved him in a different spot and told me he was fine. They didn't even look at the wound, and my puppy came home bleeding.
Then I took him back for something else, and they let him die.
Negligence. Inexperience.
Dr Benjamin in addition to being a great Dr with deep understanding, is truly compassionate not just to the animals but also to the owners.

My mom and I have been bringing our cats here for years but after our last experience, we’ll be looking for a different vet.

My mother was scheduled for a 5pm appointment on a weekday for our senior cat, which she had to leave work early for. Our cat can get very aggressive, so even trying to get him into the carrier was a whole process that took over 30 minutes and caused a tremendous amount of stress for us and our cat. My mother arrived at the clinic before the appointment, and after being made to wait, she was told by the lady vet who was filling in for the usual vet that they were not taking any more appointments for the day because it was already 6pm and they close at 7. After letting the vet know that she’d been waiting since 5, the vet rudely responded “well why did you come so late?” As if they weren’t the ones who scheduled her for that time and had her waiting.

At no point did they apologize or even acknowledge the huge inconvenience they caused. Needless to say this was a huge waste of time and money since my mother had to uber there and back, not to mention the toll it took on our poor cat.

This place isn't equipped to conduct any dog hearing test.
"Brainstem Auditory Evoked Response (BAER)"
Don't waste your money here go somewhere else.

My son and I took our cat to the vet because she wasn't eating.  Two months ago, she had a physical exam, and the doctor said her organs were fine. This Saturday morning, the supposed doctor wanted to do an X-ray. They took my cat away and brought her back dead. They were unprofessional, they didn't give me any options, and they only care about money. So think very carefully before taking your pets there. There were more than five people looking at my cat's condition, and none of them could determine that she was in danger of dying. It's so sad that you take your pet in for one reason and then they give her back to you dead.

I brought our family’s 16-year-old senior cat, Sonny, here for the first time after he hadn’t been to a vet in years, and overall we had a positive experience.

The wait wasn’t long, which we really appreciated. The clinic itself is a bit older in appearance, but the staff was very kind and welcoming. Julie in particular was wonderful — she made us feel at ease, didn’t pressure us into anything, and was so patient while handling our very spicy senior cat.

Dr. Papak was knowledgeable and thorough, and we really appreciated that she is bilingual. That was a big plus for our family since Sonny lives with my Spanish-speaking parents, and it helped ensure everything was clearly understood. We were also happy to hear that, at 16 years old, Sonny’s teeth and overall condition looked great.

At one point, the communication in the exam room felt a little tense, and I just hope staff interactions can always feel as supportive as the care they provide, especially since the techs were doing such a great job with a difficult patient.

Overall, Sonny received good care, the team was kind, and the location is very convenient for us, so we would return.

i had a bad experience with them. Took a kitten that had gotten ran over, they did xrays and found no broken bones. Took it to another vet and they found that most of its bttom half had been crushed and multiple bones broken. I wouldnt recommend them.
Great people providing great service

I’ve been coming to St. Mina for the past several years and can’t thank Dr. Benyamen and his staff enough. The compassionate and exceptional care that I’ve received for my two cats has been incredible!!
This clinic is open 7 days per week and they make it so convenient for their clients. From the moment I walked thru the doors years ago, I was met with a warm welcome and smile. The staff at the front desk (Kris, Poosh, etc), and the techs (Cynthia, Tia, Jennifer, etc), are so pleasant to interact with. They never seem stressed or unpleasant no matter how busy it is. I’m so glad that Dr. Benyamen hires exceptional staff because it truly makes such a difference!
Dr. Benyamen is a very skilled vet! Always greets his clients with a smile and has such respect and compassion for the animals.  He has accurately diagnosed and treated my two cats in the past. Both are doing great today because of Dr. Benyamen. He works with a few other vets (Dr. Ibrahim, Dr. Papak, and more), at this clinic and all are just as skilled and knowledgeable as he is. The prices here are very reasonable and affordable compared to other clinics in Queens and Brooklyn.
I will not trust my cats with any other vet except St. Mina Animal Clinic neither should you. Give them a try. You won’t be disappointed. Thanks, St. Mina!

one of the best animal clinics I’ve ever been too!! I called and asked to be seen since my dog had issues with his anal glands. They gladly took us in! The wait was 15- 20 minutes literally. I will absolutely be coming back it’s truly affordable and everyone is so caring! Dr.Papak & Julie and others were amazing with patient/animal care. I’m blown away and grateful.
They take good care of my little chinese crested chihuahua.

St Mina Animal Clinic is the best. They are only Veterinary Doctors, all the staff member's and gorgeous reception, also cute black and white cat, that I trust with my frisky babies. GOD BLESS, U ALL! 🐈🐈‍⬛🐈🐈‍⬛😻😻

I am writing this with a heavy heart after losing two cats following visits to this establishment.

The first cat was one we rescued after finding her on the road. Two doctors were involved in her care. One gave us hope, only for the second doctor to later tell us that hope was false and given so we would return. He also failed to fully review or explain her lab work, leaving out important details that could have changed our decisions. She passed away shortly after.

About a month later, we brought another cat in for what appeared to be a simple sniffle. He was otherwise healthy. After being given an injection, he lost all motor function, became completely paralyzed, and died within that week. Watching that happen was absolutely devastating.

The lack of communication and continuity of care is deeply concerning. Too many different veterinarians, too many conflicting opinions, and not enough transparency. In our case, that lack of coordination likely led to tragic outcomes.

I will never bring another animal here and urge others to ask questions and pay very close attention if they do.

SINCE IM UNABLE TO RESPOND…
The appointment was made under the name David Smith. Payment was made with my card under the name Bonnita Bell.
Responding as if you do not recognize the cat shown in the photo is concerning and this response was unprofessional. First learn proper professional etiquette then get it together. Second maybe you can review your payment history to jog your memory since a clean photo of both cats wasn’t enough.

Br. Benyamin is the best vet !! I take my cat to St Mina for years and each of my 2 daughters take their dog there !!  I would never go to another vet !! Making an appointment?? Ask for Dr. Benyamin !!

I took my kitten here for the kitten plan, and it was okay overall. I paid $300, and I honestly chose this place because it was close and convenient — but look what that got me. It felt unprofessional that they didn’t send reminders by text or phone call. I know it’s our responsibility to keep track of appointments, but it would be NICE to have that option like every other vet offers and plus its their job to do so. I ended up having to call the receptionist to confirm my appointment. She was alright, I guess, but I wish the front desk had someone more positive and passionate so I could feel better about taking my precious kitten there. But I will say that the doctor himself was a really nice guy, and the vet tech was wonderful — gentle, patient, and cautious with my kitten. They were the best part of the visit.

Brought my 2 elder kitties from upstate NY on the advice of a friend who also rescues stray, lost, abandoned friends😺 Dr. Benjamin & his staff are incredible. My 2 kitties' went through very necessary dental extractions and everything went well. Everyone there was responsive, and I noticed how the staff takes their attention to emergencies on the spot. So waiting could happen.

Highly recommend St. Minas Vet Hospital to anyone looking for a trustworthy, caring, and knowledgeable team to look after their pets. They’re simply the best!

i hope that the vets & receptionist take a good look at their Google reviews & take every single word into consideration. they are the most unprofessional animal clinic in New York. the vets are aggressive, god knows how they treat our pets when we aren’t looking. they’re mean and unorganized. my cat got neutered here and they didn’t even bother to put a cone on him. Nor did they even bother to give him any medicine like a good vet tech would do. If you love your pets do not come here.

please, if you value your pets do not waste your money here. you will definitely save your time and your pet’s health. i’ve brought my pet here twice and it was already enough for me to see that nothing that goes on here is serious. the doctors are so blatantly rude. i made an appointment to get my cat neutered. on the day of my appointment i was told the procedure couldn’t be done because my cat had eaten the day of. something like this should’ve been discussed during the phone call ive had with whatever receptionist answered the phone. i rescheduled for the next day, dropped my cat off, and was told i’d get a call back whenever he was ready. 6 hours had passed and no call or updates. i had to call to ask if my cat was okay and ready to be picked up, very unprofessional. after the procedure i came to pick my cat up, and i immediately notice he does not have a collar on him. i asked them about this because i know how my pet is, i know he likes to lick, i was then told by the front desk receptionist that he’ll be okay he doesn’t need it, just to keep an eye on him. a few hours after i brought my cat home, one of his stitches popped open and i had to rush him to the er. these people run an unorganized cheap animal clinic. not only was my cat not provided an e-collar, he also received no recovery medications! please read all of the bad reviews about this place because they outshine the good ones and they are 1000% telling the truth. this place is sick, dirty, and steals money while they try to market their business as “affordable care”. i should’ve listened to my gut and never trusted them with anything. stay far away from st mina’s.
The best animal hospital ever

The most horrific, traumatic experience I have ever had here. They’re money hungry and disgusting. We had my elderly, childhood dog put down here and when we decided to do so, we were met with attitude and given a cold shoulder. My brothers and I were there with my dog to put her to sleep and while ai expressed that I did not want to be in the room when it occurred, the vet decided to go ahead and do it in a painful way for my dog, while I was in the room. The door was wide open and guests were looking in while this happened. After she passed, he left the room leaving her dead on the table. My brother had to take her and place her in the cardboard box that they left for us. There was no compassion or care for us or my dog.  Absolutely disgusting and I am still scarred to this day. This happened a few years back but I have had a hard time getting on here to write this. Would never recommend or return.

There's no Saint in St Mina !
I took my little toy pomeranian on 7/15 to St Mina she was urinating with blood , I was assuming she had a bad uti infection. After waiting almost 40 minutes after our appointment time,  the nice vet-tech called us into one of the exam rooms where our dog was weighed and temp checked, the Vet came in and said that we needed 2 X-rays which would cost $210 + $70 office visit , ok.
After the Xray we where told that our pom had bladder stones and that she required surgery costing close to $4000.
We could not afford that since we are retired with limited income. We left saddened about the possibility of having to put our baby down. That evening I took our dog out to pee and thank god she completely emptied her bladder along with 12 stones . She was doing much better. Two days later I call St Mina and asked if I could be given a prescription for the Hills Science dog food for uti and for antibiotics the Vet absolutely refused and said the only option was surgery . I google searched for the stones my dog excreted and found the were the common struvite stones and during continued research found x-ray images of a dog with bladder stones and to my amazement it appeared to be exactly like the X-ray
the Vet showed me. A friend of ours gave us some dog amoxicillen and have been giving her UTI supplements and have changed her diet along with dl-methionine. She excreted 13 more stones since. My little Pom has completely returned to her former self.
I Thank God for giving me back our pom.
As for St Mina animal clinic you must decide . Research the owners and Vets and if you find no info that should set off alarm bells in you head .Good luck with your Pet .

I went to this clinic because I moved to a different neighborhood. I have four cats, and my previous clinic, along with its doctors and staff, was wonderful, so I know by the experience what my cats need. The first time at this Clinic, the Doctor  took a minute to see my kitten and he was rude and with bad actitudes just cause I don’t have money to pay a lot of exams he want I do for my kitten, I was thinking my kitten needs the same shots and exams than my others cats so that time I didn’t have enough money to pay  a lot of unnecessary exams. I think that doctors just are looking for money more than the pet’s security. The second time I went for booster shots for my cat. They left me waiting in a room for over half an hour, and when I got up to finally leave, a young lady came to say they had an emergency. She asked me the reason for my visit. I explained, and she try to proceeded to get shots to give my cat without even checking which booster shots he needed and I told her no!!, you don't even know what my kitty needs, you just asked me and you didn't even check his medical history, so I stood up and left. And I'm so sorry for the loss of your cat, but the poor care they've provided has been going on for a long time.
thank you we really appreciate your trust

BEWARE, cheap and affordable doesn't always mean good care. I came here for a year since this had the best reviews in Woodhaven.
Unfortunately, my kitten died after a spay procedure here.

They made us wait until closing because they said they needed to watch her a little longer, said everything was fine when they finally returned her. BUT, she had bloody and loose stitches, and her eyes were glazed over. She needed the ER that night and passed away.

The cherry on top is, I had informed the staff that she had passed but they still called me TWICE a few days later about bringing her in for a checkup.

So I made an appointment for 12:30pm when I got there the place was totally empty for the exception of an animal having surgery. After 25 mins, I ask how much longer cause I'm the only person in the room, and I had someone waiting in a vehicle that had to go to work. They said they were cleaning a room and asked me to come in with my dog. I get in the room and 10 minutes later I once again asked how much longer the young lady said very soon and before she closed the door I said that I had someone waiting outside in a vehicle for us and if it was going to be another 15 mins I would reschedule.  She said, "Let me check.  Another 10 minutes go by, and I storm out, saying this is ridiculous 45 minutes waiting with no respect to the fact that I had to go. Oh, she had asked me if I would be ok with another vet that had never seen my dog, and  I even said yes cause we were only there for an allergy shot. My biggest gripe is that I've been vocal about how happy I am with the staff and Vets and they really do a great job with animals but to give an appointment to someone with an empty place and not even call back to apologize when I stormed out is ridiculous. My dog Missy was the only name on their board, so they definitely know who I am. My dog has only come to this Vet for close to 3 years. Don't you think an apology was due. Sad that you're willing to lose good clients when all it would have taken was to tell me to reschedule due to the long wait or there lack of more Vets this day.

I wrote a review for Dr. Benyamen five years ago, and I’m happy to say that everything I said back then still holds true—if not even more so. He’s still the only vet I trust with my dog, and I wouldn’t go anywhere else. He’s been caring for my dog since she was a puppy, and all these years later, the level of care, honesty, and compassion has never changed.

Dr. Benyamen is incredibly kind and professional. He never pushes unnecessary tests or treatments and always takes the time to explain every option clearly, so you can make the best decision for your pet. His integrity and genuine love for animals really stand out.

His staff is just as lovely—always welcoming, helpful, and gentle with the animals. You can tell they truly care about every pet that walks through the door.

Even though I drive in from another borough, I do it gladly because I know my dog is in the best hands. Parking is usually fine, with meter spots nearby depending on the time.

His prices are reasonable, and most importantly, your pet’s well-being is always the top priority. I’m so grateful for Dr. Benyamen and his amazing team. After all these years, I still highly recommend him—he’s the best.
It’s a great animal clinic. Dr. Benjamin is very caring and he know his job and medicine for animals well. I am not sure about the other doctors but great experience so far.

Yes me and the wife took loki to the clinic and the we are very happy with the veterinarian and everything worked out I would recommend this place to anyone who has a cat or dog we were very satisfied thank you
thank you we really appreciate your trust
St. Mina’s vets and techs are compassionate and friendly towards pets! My pup is nervous around people and they make him feel at home. Thank you!
Wonderful staff and very caring doctors
So grateful for this vet! Others recommended surgery or couldn’t diagnose, but they gave simple meds that helped my cat recover. Always kind and helpful—truly the best!

We have trusted our cats to the care of Dr Benyamen for over 10years now. He is a rare kind of veterinarian that truly cares for the animal. Not just the money.
Most recently, our cat Merlin who turned 7 during this ordeal suddenly became very sick. Difficulty breathing, loosing weight and lethargic. It wasn't looking good and we started the discussion of letting our Merlin go. It seemed hopeless as Merlin slowly drifted away.
But Dr. Benyamen was determined to get Merlin back on track. After some conversations we decided to go with his recommendation and we all agreed that if there was no change in a day or two, it would be best to let Merlin go.
I am happy to tell you that Dr. Benyamen was right! Our Merlin is on the mend and we are seeing his personality coming back slowly. Merlin will need meds for the rest of his life, but that's ok. He is happy and comfortable.
I can't say enough about Dr. Benyamen and his staff. They are all very caring and make you feel like family and never seem to mind even when I ask tons of questions!
Here are before and after pics of Merlin's ordeal.
Thank you Dr. Benyamen and staff for getting our Merlin back to us!! God Bless You!
